about: Works that one volume in stock holds as its parts, when the volume's own title and summary do not name them (QADFIX29, QAD 2026-11-06 case 3.1: «عندكم «الغرف الموصدة» لبول أوستر؟» → «مو متوفر» and other novels of his, while «ثلاثية نيويورك» holds it). Read by app.omnibus_part29: a part named by the visitor that is no book of its own in stock is answered with the volume. Each entry: our book_id and title, the parts under the titles a visitor may use (Arabic translations and the originals), and the source that lists the parts (BOARD.md rule 12).
